body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> 3DIS(www.3dis.co.kr) presented its glasses-less 3D LCD monitor ‘1040S’ during CES 2008.
As a parallax barrier type 3D display, the 1040S allows you to view it without wearing glasses, supporting wide viewing angle for many people to watch it simultaneously.

To solve a brightness problem considered as a defect of the parallax barrier method, it adopted ‘ALT(Advanced Layer Technology)’ to offer brighter and clearer images and it also employed microchip controlling technology to deliver 2D/3D transition only by a switch.

The 1040S employed ‘3DIS Stereoscopic Player’, the company’s exclusive software which makes users enjoy 3D content more clearly and it also has cost competitiveness by enhancing efficiency in its manufacturing process.

“Through this exhibition, we found a new possibility to adopt our 3D monitor to various applications like medical equipment, game(casino), navigation, etc. We will develop additional products and preoccupy the US market with the partners who we met during this show,” the company said.
